data.description: Discover the Peaceful Charm of Al Warqa in the Heart of Dubai.

data.answer:
Living in Al Warqa Dubai offers a suburban feel with the benefits of city life nearby. The area is ideal for families, featuring ample parks, recreational areas, and educational institutions. Al Warqa is well-planned, with wide streets and dedicated parking spaces, making it convenient for residents with vehicles. 

Its peaceful environment and the availability of schools, shopping centers, and restaurants contribute to its popularity as a residential neighborhood. Al Warqa proudly hosts Dubai Safari Park, one of the largest safari parks in the UAE, and boasts three community parks spread across its sub-communities. 

Additionally, the area has several clinics and healthcare centers, ensuring that medical services are easily accessible. Whether you are a young professional looking for a serene living space or a family seeking proximity to schools and green spaces, Al Warqa offers a well-rounded residential experience.

Since the initial construction of Al Warqa, the popularity of residential properties in the area has grown significantly. The community now offers a range of options for both renters and buyers. Rental properties include a variety of apartments and spacious villas, while those looking to purchase property will find mostly independent villas.

Al Warqa’s apartment buildings are typically midrise, arranged in well-spaced clusters to avoid congestion. These buildings feature modern amenities such as on-site maintenance, tight security with CCTV, central air conditioning, and concierge services. Residences often include facilities like kids' play areas, swimming pools, and high-speed elevators. 

Each apartment is designed with en-suite bedrooms, ample closet space, and kitchens with marble countertops. It also offers balconies with city views for natural light and ventilation. Al Warqa presents a range of standalone homes on the villa side, blending traditional architecture with modern amenities. The villas showcase large windows and landscaped courtyards with greenery, and some feature private swimming pools or water fountains. 

Sizes range from 1,200 sq. ft. to 12,000 sq. ft., with larger villas often including garages for up to four vehicles. The area, particularly Al Warqa 3 and Al Warqa 2, has become a sought after location for those seeking luxurious living away from the city’s bustle.

Renting a Property in Al Warqa Dubai

Looking for a rental property in Dubai? Renting properties in Al Warqa, Dubai, is popular among professionals and families due to its competitive prices and diverse housing options. Al Warqa offers more affordable rental rates compared to more central locations in Dubai, while still providing modern amenities and a comfortable lifestyle.

For apartments, rental prices in Al Warqa are reasonable, with studios starting at AED 37k per year, 1-bedroom apartments at AED 46k, 2-bedroom units at AED 64k, and 3-bedroom apartments available for AED 108k annually.

This makes it an attractive choice for individuals and small families seeking budget-friendly accommodations.
In addition to apartments, Al Warqa also offers a variety of spacious villas, ideal for larger families or those seeking more privacy. A 2-bedroom villa typically rents for AED 85k, while 3-bedroom villas are priced around AED 184k. For even more space, 4-bedroom villas rent for AED 269k, and 5-bedroom villas are available at AED 298k, offering luxury living at competitive rates compared to other parts of Dubai.

Buying a Property in Al Warqa Dubai

Al Warqa, Dubai, is an attractive area for property investment in Dubai, offering a range of options at prices considerably lower than those in Dubai’s central regions. The area is especially renowned for its spacious villas, which are popular among buyers looking for luxury and comfort. With its affordability and well-designed properties, Al Warqa has become a sought-after location for both residents and investors.

Property prices in Al Warqa present a great value proposition, particularly for those interested in villas. A 4-bedroom villa typically starts at AED 4 million, while 5-bedroom villas are priced from AED 5 million. For those seeking even more space, larger mansions with up to 8 bedrooms have an average cost of around AED 7 million. These properties boast modern designs, spacious layouts, and high-quality construction, making them ideal for families and investors alike.

The continuous development in Al Warqa further enhances its appeal, making it a strong choice for both personal residence and long-term investment. Whether you're looking to buy for personal use or lease the property, Al Warqa offers a promising real estate market with a blend of affordability, quality, and the potential for capital growth.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Warqa Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Al Warqa Dubai is serene and community-focused. The area is designed to cater to the needs of families and professionals. Residents enjoy the convenience of having everything they need nearby, from schools to parks to supermarkets. 

With plenty of green spaces and parks, Al Warqa provides an environment where families can relax and enjoy outdoor activities. Additionally, the proximity to major highways makes commuting to other parts of Dubai easy and efficient.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Warqa Dubai

Transportation and parking in Al Warqa, Dubai, are convenient for residents and visitors alike. The area is well-connected to major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Ras Al Khor Road, ensuring easy access to key parts of the city. 

Public transportation options, such as buses, are readily available, with multiple bus routes serving the area. While the nearest metro station, Centerpoint, is a short drive away, residents often rely on personal vehicles. Parking spaces are abundant, with most residential properties, including villas and apartments, offering dedicated parking spots, making Al Warqa an ideal location for car owners.

Supermarkets in Al Warqa Dubai

Convenient Access: Supermarkets are easily accessible from each sub-community within Al Warqa, ensuring residents can quickly meet their grocery needs.

Supermarkets In and Near Al Warqa

Al Warqa, Dubai, offers a variety of supermarkets to cater to the daily needs of its residents. Among the major supermarkets, Shaklan stands out for its wide range of products and competitive prices, while Spinneys is known for offering fresh produce, household items, and imported goods. Lulu Hypermarket provides an extensive selection, from groceries to electronics, and Aswaaq Supermarket is a favorite for everyday essentials.

In addition to these, there are other options such as Grandiose Supermarket, which is popular for its high-quality products and service, and Star Warqaa Supermarket, a local favorite known for convenience and affordability.Madina Al Warqa Supermarket also serves the community with a broad range of grocery items and household necessities. Alongside these major supermarkets, residents can find numerous smaller grocery and convenience stores spread throughout the area, ensuring easy access to essentials at all times.

Shopping Mall in Al Warqa Dubai

Al Warqa Mall is a popular destination for residents looking for shopping, dining, and entertainment options. The mall features a range of retail stores offering everything from fashion to electronics. In addition to shopping, Al Warqa Mall also houses a selection of restaurants and cafes, making it a great place to spend a leisurely day with family and friends. 

The mall is also home to Al Warqa Mall Salon, a beauty salon offering various services, from haircuts to spa treatments. With new shops and services continually being added, the mall is becoming a central hub for the community.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Al Warqa Dubai

Al Warqa, Dubai, is well-served by a variety of schools and nurseries, providing convenient access to quality education for families in the area. Our Own English High School, located in the nearby Al Warqa 3 area, is only a 5-minute drive away, offering a well-rounded curriculum for students. For younger children, Little Flowers Nursery is also situated within Al Warqa and can be reached in approximately 7 minutes by car.

In the neighboring Mirdif community, about 10 minutes from Al Warqa, you'll find Mirdif American School, known for its American curriculum, and Emirates British Nursery, which is also around 10 minutes away. These schools and nurseries provide a range of educational options for families, ensuring that both primary and early education needs are met with minimal commuting time.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Al Warqa Dubai Location

Al Warqa is a diverse community that provides convenient access to places of worship for various faiths. For the Muslim residents, the area boasts several mosques, including the Al Warqa Grand Mosque, Sheikh Rashid Bin Maktoum Bin Rashid Mosque, Tareeq Al Jannah Mosque, and Qubah Masjid, all of which cater to daily prayers and unique services. 

For those of Christian faith, a range of churches can be found in Deira, about a 25-minute drive from Al Warqa. Notable churches include Winners Chapel International Dubai, International Baptist Church, JA1 Church, and Apostolic Church. 

Sikh residents can visit the Automech Gurudwara in Nad Al Sheba, while the Gurudwara and Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple are located in Bur Dubai, roughly 30 minutes away. Hindu worshippers can also find the Shiva and Krishna Temple in Bur Dubai. These diverse religious facilities reflect Al Warqa’s multicultural character and provide residents ample opportunities to practice their faith.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Al Warqa Dubai Area

Residents of Al Warqa have access to quality healthcare facilities within the community. Aster Clinic and Zulekha Hospital are two popular healthcare providers in the area, offering various medical services, from general consultations to specialized treatments. Additionally, several smaller clinics and pharmacies are scattered throughout the community, making healthcare accessible to all residents.

Al Warqa Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Al Warqa Dubai is close to key areas like Mirdif, Nad Al Hammar, and Ras Al Khor. Its strategic location makes it easy for residents to commute to different parts of Dubai via major highways. The Al Warqa Dubai location map highlights its accessibility to essential amenities and services, making it a convenient place to live for families and professionals alike.

These beaches offer an excellent escape for those looking to enjoy a day of sun, sand, and sea. From water sports to beachside cafes, there’s plenty to do for a relaxing weekend by the water.

These hotels are conveniently located near key landmarks and transportation links, making them ideal for tourists and business travelers. For those who prefer luxurious stays, options such as Le Meridien Dubai Hotel & Conference Centre and Crowne Plaza Dubai are just a short drive away, offering high-end facilities and world-class service.

Additionally, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is nearby, where residents and visitors can observe migratory birds and other wildlife in their natural habitat. For entertainment and shopping, residents can visit the nearby City Centre Mirdif, which offers many retail outlets, cinemas, and entertainment facilities.

Outdoor activities are plentiful in the area's well-maintained parks, perfect for jogging, cycling, and leisurely walks. The gyms in Al Warqa cater to different fitness levels, providing personal training sessions, group fitness classes, and specialized fitness programs. data.content:
Al Warqa is a well-established residential community located in the eastern region of Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and spacious villas. It is divided into 5 sub communities including Al Warqaa 1, Al Warqaa 2, Al Warqaa 3, Al Warqaa 4, and Al Warqaa 5. Al Warqa offers a range of residential options, primarily featuring large villas and a few low-rise apartment buildings. 

One of the key attractions of Al Warqa is its proximity to major landmarks and leisure destinations. The area is located near the iconic Dubai Safari Park, a major wildlife attraction, and Mushrif Park, a large outdoor recreational space perfect for family outings, picnics, and nature walks. Al Warqa residents enjoy easy access to several schools, supermarkets, clinics, and fitness centers, providing all the essentials needed for a comfortable and convenient lifestyle.

Al Warqa is close to several shopping malls, dining options, and entertainment hubs, ensuring residents are never too far from the excitement of city life. The community's affordable real estate options, compared to more central parts of Dubai, offer a great value proposition for those seeking a peaceful, yet well-connected, place to call home.

nodes.title: Al Warqa 3
nodes.about:
Al Warqa 3 Dubai is the third neighborhood of five in the Al Warqa residential area. It is located on the southeast side of Dubai Creek as it is a beautiful urban residential area ideal for families and individuals alike. The community includes villas and apartments and offers all major amenities within easy reach. Community parks, sports fields and playgrounds make this an attractive location for families with children.

There are many schools nearby Al Warqa 3, including Ignite School 0.9 km away and GEMS' own English medium school 1.0 km away. As for supermarkets and hypermarkets, there are several options in the area. For example, Fresh & Fast grocery stores, as well as Al Taif Star Grocery and Shorooq Al Warqa Grocery Store. Al Warqa 3 Dubai Park is the largest park in the neighborhood. It is also known as the Great Warqa Park.

Like the rest of the residential neighborhood, Al Warqa 3 is close to many bus stations. This makes it easy to travel to and from this neighborhood in Dubai. From the complex, it takes about 19 minutes to Dubai Mall, 30 minutes to Palm Jumeirah, 29 minutes to Burj Al Arab and 34 minutes to Walk JBR.

Dubai International Airport (DXB) is approximately 14 minutes away and the new Al Maktoum International Airport is approximately 44 minutes away.
